meta.title: Company Profile
meta.description: Intisukses Mitratama Mandiri is a company providing HVAC installation, maintenance, and servicing services in Indonesia

ihktisar: Building upon the rapidly growing business operations of PT Intisukses Mitra Sejati in the HVAC-R (Heating, Ventilating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration) and M&E (Mechanical & Electrical) sectors—and in response to customer demand for engineering support—PT Intisukses Mitratama Mandiri was established in 2017. The company focuses on contracting services, specifically installation, maintenance, and repair.

By steadfastly prioritizing customer satisfaction through rapid response times—backed by a skilled workforce, appropriate tools and technology, and support from principals—PT Intisukses Mitratama Mandiri has grown rapidly. This success is evidenced by the trust placed in our company (often referred to as IM2) to serve as a subcontractor or engineering dealer for various principals, including Daikin, McQuay, Mitsubishi, Panasonic, Samsung, Wika, and others.
IM2 has also earned the trust of a wide range of clients—including office buildings, factories, and luxury residences—who rely on us for high-quality service.

description: Born in Jakarta and earned a Bachelor of Economics and Accounting degree from Atma Jaya Catholic University in 1993. Since elementary school, I have been involved in the family business as a retailer, which laid the foundation for my understanding of the business world.

In 1991, while still at university, he began working as a professional at a tax consultancy, and from 1992 to 2013, he worked in the fields of accounting and finance. These experiences proved invaluable in building his business later on. In 2003, he started a retail business and successfully expanded it.
Five years later, he founded PT Intisukses Mitra Sejati, the company that served as the foundation for subsequent business expansion.

In 2012, he established a second company specializing in cement distribution in collaboration with a business partner; since then, he has continued to innovate and found several other companies across various business sectors.
Backed by experience and a strong vision, we are committed to continuously developing a sustainable business and making a positive contribution to stakeholders.s

meta.title: AC & HVACR Installation Services
meta.description: Professional installation services for AC, VRF/VRV, chillers, and commercial heat pumps by certified engineers. Precise, clean, and fully guaranteed

instalasi-ac.header_01: Performed by Experienced and Professional Technicians
instalasi-ac.desc_01: Every AC installation is handled by trained technicians who understand safety standards and unit technical specifications. With experience handling various types and capacities of AC units, we ensure the installation process is quick, neat, and tailored to your room's requirements.
instalasi-ac.desc_02: Throughout the partnership, we also provide maintenance services to ensure that air conditioners, water heaters, and heat pumps always operate optimally. This service is designed to keep the equipment in top condition and prevent breakdowns before they occur
instalasi-ac.scope_desc: We execute every installation project through clear stages—from initial survey to handover—ensuring measurable and accountable results.
instalasi-ac.scope_01_desc: Assessment of room conditions, piping routes, and electrical power requirements prior to installation.
instalasi-ac.scope_02_desc: Placement of brackets and units in accordance with airflow standards and room aesthetics.
instalasi-ac.scope_03_desc: Installation of refrigerant piping, power cables, and drainage lines with neat routing.
instalasi-ac.scope_04_desc: System vacuuming and refrigerant charging processes based on unit specifications.
instalasi-ac.scope_05_desc: Testing of pressure, leaks, and cooling performance before the unit is declared ready for use.
instalasi-ac.scope_06_desc: Documentation of work results, operational briefing, and activation of the workmanship warranty.
instalasi-ac.benefit_desc: A correctly installed system operates at its nominal capacity, consumes energy as designed, and reaches its intended lifespan. We ensure your cooling system performs flawlessly from day one.
instalasi-ac.benefit_content: An improperly installed AC unit can lose 15–25% of its efficiency from day one. Correct pipe sizing and proper vacuuming save electricity and extend the compressor's lifespan.
instalasi-ac.benefit_img_desc: Every installation is executed systematically following strict checklists and factory tolerances.
instalasi-ac.benefit_card_03: Three fundamental principles upheld by our technicians during every residential and commercial cooling unit installation.
instalasi-ac.benefit_presisi_desc: Every angle, level, and piping run is executed with millimetre accuracy. Precision machine-flared joints guarantee leak-free connections without vibration.
instalasi-ac.benefit_kebersihan_desc: Work areas are protected with safety covers. Pipes and cabling are routed neatly to preserve aesthetics, and all debris is thoroughly cleaned upon completion.
instalasi-ac.benefit_kebersihan_point_01: Protective dust covers for work areas
instalasi-ac.benefit_hemat_daya_desc: Thorough system vacuuming, tight thermal insulation, and optimal placement keep compressor workloads light, significantly reducing power consumption from day one.

meta.title: HEPA Filter Design & Installation Services
meta.description: High-precision air quality solutions for facilities requiring strict air cleanliness standards, covering everything from system design to installation

instalasi-hepa.header_01: Professional HEPA Filter System Design & Installation
instalasi-hepa.desc_01: We provide comprehensive solutions ranging from planning and air exchange calculations to the installation of HEPA/ULPA filter systems. Precision-engineered to meet air cleanliness standards for operating rooms, the pharmaceutical industry, laboratories, and manufacturing cleanrooms.
instalasi-hepa.desc_02: Throughout our partnership, we also provide maintenance services to ensure that HVAC units, HEPA filters, and chillers consistently operate at peak performance. These services are designed to keep equipment in optimal condition and prevent breakdowns before they occur.
instalasi-hepa.scope_title: HEPA Filter System Scope of Work
instalasi-hepa.scope_desc: Our structured approach ensures every stage of unit design and installation aligns with the room's required technical specifications
instalasi-hepa.scope_01_desc: Designing airflow patterns (laminar/turbulent), contamination criteria, and air exchange specifications (ACH) in accordance with ISO 14644 & CPOB standards
instalasi-hepa.scope_02_desc: Installation of FFU/HEPA box units featuring hermetic sealing systems and integration with precision-pressurized ducting
instalasi-hepa.scope_03_desc: Testing filter media and gasket integrity using PAO/DOP aerosol methods to ensure zero contaminant leakage
instalasi-hepa.scope_04_desc: Adjusting and balancing air volume and inter-room differential pressure (positive/negative pressure rooms)
instalasi-hepa.scope_05_desc: Preparation of Installation Qualification (IQ) and Operational Qualification (OQ) documentation for industry audits and validation requirements
instalasi-hepa.scope_06_desc: Documentation of work results, explanation of usage, and activation of the workmanship warranty.
instalasi-hepa.benefit_desc: Installing a HEPA filter involves more than just placing the unit in the ceiling or ductwork. Precision in gasket installation, frame tightness, and air pressure balance determine whether your room passes air cleanliness validation tests.
instalasi-hepa.benefit_content: Every installation is verified using an aerosol photometer to ensure there is no bypass or microscopic damage to the filter media.
instalasi-hepa.benefit_img_desc: Ensuring filtration performance remains optimal and consistent with air cleanliness standards.
instalasi-hepa.benefit_card_03: Three core principles upheld by our technicians during every installation of residential and commercial cooling units.
instalasi-hepa.benefit_presisi_desc: Utilizing medical and pharmaceutical-grade H13/H14 HEPA filters to capture particles as small as 0.3 microns.
instalasi-hepa.benefit_kebersihan_desc: Corrosion-resistant housing construction (stainless steel or powder-coated mild steel) ensuring long-term structural integrity
instalasi-hepa.benefit_kebersihan_point_01: Dust protection cover for the work area
instalasi-hepa.benefit_hemat_daya_desc: Designed for low initial pressure drop to reduce the workload on AHUs or fan units

meta.title: Chiller Design & Installation Services
meta.description: Achieve energy efficiency and optimal cooling performance for your building. Our team of expert technicians designs and installs custom chiller plants with high safety standards and precision accuracy.

instalasi-chiller.header_01: Well-Planned, Precise, and Efficient Design for Your Chiller Installation System
instalasi-chiller.desc_01: Achieve energy efficiency and optimal cooling performance for your building. Our team of expert technicians designs and installs custom chiller plants with high safety standards and precision accuracy.
instalasi-chiller.scope_desc: We execute every installation project through clear, defined stages—from initial survey to handover—ensuring measurable and accountable results.
instalasi-chiller.scope_01_desc: Cooling load calculations, chiller plant layout analysis, and mapping of electrical capacity and water flow prior to fabrication
instalasi-chiller.scope_02_desc: Placement of chiller units (Air/Water-Cooled), cooling towers, and pumping systems in accordance with structural standards and vibration isolation requirements
instalasi-chiller.scope_03_desc: Installation of chilled water piping (with thermal insulation), main power cabling, and seamless integration of control panels/BMS
instalasi-chiller.scope_04_desc: Pipeline cleaning (flushing), hydrostatic pressure testing, vacuuming, and refrigerant charging according to unit technical specifications
instalasi-chiller.scope_05_desc: Testing of flow rates, Delta T, and pressure balance, along with system performance simulations before the chiller is certified ready for operation
instalasi-chiller.scope_06_desc: Document handover as-built drawings, chiller system operating manual, building operator training, and installation warranty activation
instalasi-chiller.benefit_title: Why Proper Chiller Design & Installation is Crucial
instalasi-chiller.benefit_desc: The chiller plant is the single largest cooling energy consumer in commercial and industrial facilities (accounting for 40-60% of total building energy). Precision hydraulic design and installation guarantee optimal efficiency, eliminate Low Delta T Syndrome, and safeguard high-value compressor assets.
instalasi-chiller.benefit_content: Improper pipe sizing and flow rate imbalances can trigger Low Delta T Syndrome, wasting up to 25% extra energy. Proper hydraulic balancing ensures chillers operate at their lowest nominal kW/TR rating.
instalasi-chiller.benefit_img_desc: Every installation follows rigorous engineering checklists, flow balancing tests, and manufacturer tolerances.
instalasi-chiller.benefit_card_02: Precision Engineering, System Integrity, and Energy Efficiency
instalasi-chiller.benefit_card_03: Three engineering standards implemented by our expert team to ensure maximum reliability for commercial buildings, hospitals, data centers, and industrial facilities.
instalasi-chiller.benefit_presisi_desc: Comprehensive cooling load calculations, precision hydraulic piping design, and accurate pump head estimation ensure uniform chilled water distribution across all AHUs/FCUs without flow dead spots.
instalasi-chiller.benefit_presisi_point_01: Accurate thermal load & flow rate sizing
instalasi-chiller.benefit_kebersihan_desc: Implementation of ASME/ASTM piping standards, chemical flushing to eliminate weld slag and scale, plus vapor-sealed thermal insulation to prevent condensation and premature corrosion.
instalasi-chiller.benefit_kebersihan_point_03: Hydrostatic pressure test at 1.5x working pressure
instalasi-chiller.benefit_hemat_daya_desc: Adoption of Variable Primary Flow (VPF), VFD modulation on pumps, and Building Management System (BMS) integration to achieve the lowest power consumption ratio (optimal kW/TR).

meta.title: AC Maintenance & Servicing
meta.description: Periodic maintenance and preventive servicing for AC, heat pump, and water heater units by certified technicians. Clean air, lower power bills, and longer lifespan.

pemeliharaan.header: Structured Preventive Maintenance for Peak Cooling Efficiency
pemeliharaan.desc: We provide scheduled maintenance services to ensure air conditioning units, HEPA filters, and chillers consistently operate at peak efficiency, preventing premature failure and maintaining indoor air quality
pemeliharaan.scope_desc: Each service visit is conducted according to manufacturer checklist standards, ranging from physical deep-cleaning to electrical audits and performance testing.
pemeliharaan.scope_01_desc: Removal, washing, and sanitizing of indoor air filters and unit casings for clean air circulation.
pemeliharaan.scope_02_desc: Controlled high-pressure wash of evaporator fins using protective wash bags and safe cleaning agents.
pemeliharaan.scope_03_desc: Flushing of drain pans and discharge piping to eliminate slime buildup and prevent ceiling water leaks.
pemeliharaan.scope_04_desc: Pressure washing of outdoor condenser coils to ensure efficient heat dissipation for the compressor.
pemeliharaan.scope_05_desc: Measurement of refrigerant operating pressure and compressor running amperage using digital gauges.
pemeliharaan.scope_06_desc: Testing temperature drop across supply and return air, followed by formal handover of service records.
pemeliharaan.benefit_desc: Micro-dust accumulation on cooling coils reduces heat exchange efficiency by up to 25% and strains the compressor. Regular servicing keeps indoor air healthy and energy bills under control.
pemeliharaan.benefit_content: Servicing every 3 months restores cooling performance by up to 99%, cuts electricity consumption by 20–30%, and extends equipment service life.
pemeliharaan.benefit_img_desc: Our technicians always use waterproof wash bags and floor drop-cloths to keep your room spotless and dry.
pemeliharaan.benefit_card_02: Energy Efficiency, Air Hygiene, and Unit Longevity
pemeliharaan.benefit_card_03: Three tangible benefits delivered by the preventive maintenance program of PT IMM.
pemeliharaan.benefit_efisiensi_desc: Clean evaporator and condenser coils optimize heat exchange, reduce compressor workload, and directly lower monthly electricity bills.
pemeliharaan.benefit_kesehatan_desc: Eliminates mould, bacteria, slime, and musty odours inside the AC unit, ensuring the air your family or workforce breathes is always fresh.
pemeliharaan.benefit_kesehatan_point_02: Eliminates musty odours and stale dust
pemeliharaan.benefit_keawetan_desc: Early detection of potential issues such as minor leaks, weak capacitors, or blocked drains before they develop into expensive major breakdowns.
pemeliharaan.benefit_keawetan_point_02: Avoids water leaks that damage ceilings

duration.q: How long does it take to install a single AC unit?
duration.a: For standard units (1–1.5 HP), installation typically takes 1.5–2.5 hours, depending on piping distance and site conditions.

material.q: Are refrigerant (Freon) and brackets included in the service fee?
material.a: Installation fees are separate from material costs such as piping, brackets, and refrigerant. Details will be provided after a site survey or confirmation of requirements.

warranty.q: Is there a warranty after installation or repair?
warranty.a: Yes, all work is covered by an official warranty of up to 12 months for installation services, with service warranties applicable based on the type of work performed.

commercial.q: Can you handle large-scale installations for buildings or offices?
commercial.a: Yes. We offer periodic maintenance contract packages for commercial clients with large numbers of units.
